meta.name: audit-my-app
meta.description: Sweep a whole running web app for what is broken, without writing a script or knowing the codebase. Clicks every reachable control and reports dead buttons, console errors, failed requests, and places where the API and the screen disagree. Use on an unfamiliar codebase, before a release, after a big merge or dependency bump, when the user asks for a smoke test or a health check, or when someone says "just check everything still works".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 替你点遍网页里的每个按钮,把打不开的控件和报错列成清单。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果接手了别人的项目,或正要发版、心里没底想先确认一切还能正常跑。
copy.tagline_en: Click through every control in a running web app and list what's broken.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're taking over an unfamiliar app or about to ship and want proof it still works.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Reticle 遍历运行中的 Web 应用里每个可点的控件,报告失效按钮、控制台报错、失败请求,以及接口与界面不一致之处,并给出对应的文件:行。
howto.when: 用在不熟悉的代码库上、发布前、大合并或依赖升级之后;当你要求冒烟测试、健康检查,或说「看看是不是都还能用」时触发。

say.text: 跑一遍冒烟测试,看应用有哪些地方坏了
say.note: 会遍历可点控件并给出报告

say.text: 这个仓库我不熟,先做一次健康检查
接口返回十行,表格只显示九行,查一下
say.note: 会比对接口输出与渲染结果

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives Reticle through every reachable control in a running web app and reports dead buttons, console errors, failed requests, and places where the API and the screen disagree, with file:line per finding.
howto.when_en: Use on an unfamiliar codebase, before a release, or after a big merge or dependency bump; also when the user asks for a smoke test or a health check.

say_en.text: Run a smoke test and tell me what's broken in the app
I don't know this codebase — give it a health check
The API returns ten rows but the table shows nine
say_en.note: Reconciles API output against the screen
